title: Local & Home Services (trades, clinics, salons, fitness)
description: Geographically bounded, trust-gated, often urgent. Reach outside the service radius is waste, and the highest-leverage channel is the one generic tooling forgets: the map listing.

seasonality.note: Heating demand spikes within 48 hours of the first freeze. Creative must already be in the queue, not being briefed.

objection_library: will they show up when they say
will the price change once they're here
will they upsell me something I don't need
angle_library: what a bad repair looks like

lexicon.note: `free estimate` is banned only where local rules restrict it — the compliance profile decides; the lexicon flags it for screening.

creative.image_style: real work in a real property, natural available light, identifiable local context, technician in branded workwear, honest and un-retouched
creative.image_negative: generic stock tradesperson, impossibly clean work site, staged handshake, tools held wrongly, branding that misspells the company name
creative.video_style: phone-shot from the job, narrated by the person who did the work, before and after in the same framing
shot_grammar: the finished result in the same framing as the problem
what it cost and how fast

required_disclaimers.text: Pricing shown is a typical range; final quote follows an on-site assessment.

plays.title: Job of the week
plays.when: A completed job produced usable before/after evidence. The default weekly heartbeat for this vertical.

with.check: licence number present, service area accurate

plays.title: Weather-triggered urgency
plays.when: A forecast threshold in the service area is crossed. Fires automatically from a schedule/webhook, not from a human request.

plays.title: Turn finished jobs into reviews
plays.when: A job closed and the customer has not been asked.

prompt_fragments.voice: Write the way a good technician talks to a homeowner at the door: what the problem is, what it costs, how soon you can be there. No marketing register at all.
prompt_fragments.proof_instruction: Licence number, years in business, review count and a named neighbourhood outperform every adjective available to you.
prompt_fragments.visual_instruction: Real site, real light, real workwear. The before and after must share framing and lens so the change is legible instantly.
prompt_fragments.geo_instruction: Name the service area explicitly in every piece. Reach beyond the radius is spend with no possible return, and coverage claims outside it are a compliance block.
